blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Afril Bernardino believes there’s still room for improvement even after Gilas Pilipinas secured its place in the quarterfinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 women’s basketball 5-on-5 event with Sunday’s 90-73 win over Hong Kong. Gilas had to weather Hong Kong’s challenge throughout the first half and the inner half of the third before pulling away behind, among others, Bernardino, who finished with 17 points, 11 rebounds, four assists, two steals and two blocks.
